احترفتن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَرَفْتُنَّ (iḥtaraftunna) /iħ.ta.raf.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# اُحْتُرِفْتُنَّ (uḥturiftunna) /uħ.tu.rif.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
